evals.prompt: Analyze https://ansarbuilds.dev and tell me exactly what frontend technologies and animation techniques it uses. Separate facts from inference, cover mobile and reduced motion, and give me a clean-room recipe for recreating the interaction style without copying the content.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-backed stack and animation report with confidence labels, responsive/accessibility coverage, and original implementation recipes.

evals.prompt: I own the portfolio in ./portfolio-shallow/portfolio. Compare the deployed homepage with the source and produce a component-by-component motion inventory. Flag dependencies that are installed but not actually used on the homepage.
evals.expected_output: An owner-mode report comparing runtime evidence with local source imports and distinguishing shipped behavior from unused dependencies.

evals.prompt: Rebuild the feel of this agency homepage in React: https://example.com. Keep the scroll reveals and magnetic buttons but use a new layout, new colors, placeholder copy, and no downloaded brand assets.
evals.expected_output: A public-mode inspection followed by an original React implementation that recreates techniques without cloning identity, content, or proprietary assets.

evals.prompt: Extract the actual browser-visible animation evidence from https://kigo.studio, including exact keyframes, timings, selectors, asset URLs, bundle signatures, and source-map references. Then make an original React component that reproduces the ambient falling-petal technique for my own portfolio without reusing their artwork.
evals.expected_output: A forensic artifact bundle plus an original, accessible React/CSS implementation with reduced-motion support and clear separation between observed third-party evidence and reusable new code.
